subject.title: [Bug]: Dreaming - system prompt includes a lot of redundant instructions, irrelevant or invalid for dreams

question: Should OpenClaw add a constrained public plugin subagent `promptMode` override for Dreaming, rather than teaching core prompt classification about a memory-core-specific session-key prefix?
rationale: The reported bug has an established expected behavior, but the proposed repair changes a cross-plugin SDK/gateway contract; maintainer intent is needed to choose the permanent ownership boundary.

options.title: Add a constrained explicit prompt mode
options.body: Accept the linked direction, document the narrow override contract, and preserve current key-derived behavior when callers do not opt in.

options.title: Keep prompt mode inferred from session keys
options.body: Decline the new plugin contract and implement a shared classification rule only if it can remain generic and avoid memory-core-specific policy in core.

recommendation.title: Add a constrained explicit prompt mode
recommendation.body: Accept the linked direction, document the narrow override contract, and preserve current key-derived behavior when callers do not opt in.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature-history evidence ties this contributor to the Dreaming runtime boundary most affected by the API-direction choice.
